sn14.14:2.2: Those who have inferior convictions came together and converged with those who have inferior convictions;
sn14.14:2.3: Those who have good convictions came together and converged with those who have good convictions.
sn14.14:3.2: Those who have inferior convictions will join together and converge with those who have inferior convictions;
sn14.14:3.3: Those who have good convictions will join together and converge with those who have good convictions.
